meta.title: BIO:ON — Biotech & pharma news, turned into career insight
meta.description: Every Tuesday morning, BIO:ON Insight turns last week's three biggest biotech and pharma stories into insight — with the Korean angle and what they mean for your career.

home.eyebrow: Every Tuesday morning · Biotech & pharma newsletter
home.lede: Last week's three stories that matter — explained plainly, with the Korean market angle and which roles they matter for.

home.careerTitle: Reading the news is job prep
home.careerBody: Every BIO:ON story notes which roles it matters for — so when an interviewer asks "What industry news caught your eye recently?", you have a sharp answer ready.
home.heroLede: I studied Pharmacology (BSc) at UCL in London and am now doing an MSc in Biotechnology & Pharmaceutical Management there, while publishing BIO:ON Insight — last week's three biggest biotech and pharma stories, every Tuesday, read through a Korean lens and a career lens.

about.title: About
about.name: Yaehyun Lee
about.role: Editor, BIO:ON · MSc Biotechnology & Pharmaceutical Management, UCL
about.bio: BIO:ON is a newsletter that reads biotech and pharma news through a Korean lens and a career lens. Each week I read the original global coverage and add the context people preparing for the industry actually need.
about.aiTitle: A media project built with AI
about.aiLede: BIO:ON runs on an AI-assisted workflow from research to publishing. This site itself was designed and coded with Claude Code.

aiSteps.title: Research & translation
aiSteps.body: Global press releases are gathered and machine-translated first, then checked line by line against the originals.

aiSteps.title: Newsletter production
aiSteps.body: An email-safe HTML template co-designed with AI keeps the structure fixed while the content changes weekly.

aiSteps.title: Card news & reels
aiSteps.body: A pipeline turns each issue into an Instagram carousel automatically.

aiSteps.title: This website
aiSteps.body: Built from scratch in Next.js — bilingual, with automatic archive import, and AI translation, summaries and a chatbot on the way.
